messages:
infra-monitor-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: 3 nodes in infer-usw-2a pool reporting KubeletRestart + NotReady (metric spike) — affected pods: redwood-infer-pool-{gpu,worker}-* — observed container restarts with CUDA error and OOMs. Check: https://monitoring.redwood.internal/alerts/2117778888

sara: seeing same in logs, requests being retried, increased 503s on /v1/generate for dedicated customers.  p50 latency up ~120ms, p95 up ~1.4s. 5% error rate on embeddings route.

mohit: grabbing nodes now. likely cause: local SSD IO contention triggering kubelet restart loop then NotReady. GPUs showing kernel messages: `E/driver: CUDA kernel panic` in node logs.

eli: paging oncall, paging ops-pager now. I'll cordon the affected nodes to stop new pods landing.

ops-pager: oncall-1 here, seeing alerts. what's impact on in-flight requests? any customer-facing degradation confirmed?

sara: yes, customers using dedicated pools in us-west-2 are seeing tail errors and retries. routing fallback engaged but capacity is saturated — fallback models returning slower responses.

mohit: quick mitigation plan: 1) cordon + drain nodes with graceful 30s to migrate KV cache where possible 2) scale up fallback pool in another AZ 3) temporarily lower batch_size on high-latency routes 4) restart kubelet on affected nodes after cleanup.

nyla: I'm on infra-runner, prepping a node replacement job and increasing node-pool desired count by +3 in us-west-2 to shift load.

eli: executing cordon/drain for nodes node-usw2a-0{3,4,9} now:
```
kubectl cordon node-usw2a-03
kubectl drain node-usw2a-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30 -l app=infer
```

mohit: logs from node-usw2a-03 before drain:
```
[   14.123456] kubelet[1234]: E0505 12:34:56.789 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, pid=9876, clientname=rdpx
[   14.124000] dockerd: containerd: task start failed: failed to create shim task: runtime/cgo: CUDA error 
```

ops-pager: good to cordon. also trigger routing policy to exclude that AZ from serving: calling control-plane route API.

eli: doing route change now — switching infer-routing policy for us-west-2 to prefer eu-west for Dedicated as stop-gap (gradual 10% step to avoid immediate overload):
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.redwood.internal/v1/routing/policy -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${ADMIN_TOKEN}' -d '{"pool":"dedicated-usw2","prefer_regions":["eu-west-1"],"weight":10}'
```

deploy-bot: @channel deploy started: scaleup/dedicated-usw2-fallback +3 replicas (run id: deploy-9876).

sara: lowering model batch_size for embeddings route to reduce memory pressure on serving runtime: applied config change via console. Monitoring for impact.

mohit: after drains, nodes still show kubelet restart loops on two nodes. planning to reboot those hosts and apply kernel/RN fixes. will escalate to infra on-call if reboots fail.

nyla: autoscaler increased node-pool desired to +3, new nodes coming up in other AZs. starting warmup of caches to reduce cold misses.

ops-pager: any estimated RTO? customers seeing errors now but not fully degraded. need a communication update to support.

sara: ETA initial mitigation 10-15m for routing change + scaleup, full drain/reboot 25-40m. I'll post status to #incidents and ping support with temporary mitigation notes.

eli: reboot command on affected nodes (rolling):
```
ssh core@node-usw2a-03 'sudo systemctl stop kubelet && sudo reboot'
```

mohit: after reboot, node comes back Ready but one CUDA device still failing - kernel oops persisted. marking node for reprovision (image reflash) and draining it permanently: `kubectl annotate node node-usw2a-03 reprovision=true` then cordon.

nyla: reprovision job queued on infra provisioning stack. new node will replace it automatically.

infra-monitor-bot: INFO: fallback routing at 10% engaged, +3 nodes requested, observed error rate drop from 5% -> 1.8% in 7m.

eli: handing off to oncall-2 for post-incident cleanup and long-term action items. @ops-pager please take it from here.

ops-pager: accepted. I'll keep the routing preference in place until reprovision completes and we'll revert weights once pool healthy. next steps: 1) collect kernel logs and open infra ticket 2) schedule image reprovision for the two nodes 3) follow up with perf team on batch_size/quantization tuning to lower memory spikes.

mohit: adding debug artifacts to incident ticket: /var/log/messages, dmesg snippets, container logs, and gpu-driver stack traces.

sara: notifying affected customers through support with mitigation notes. support ticket templates: brief summary, ETA for full restore, workaround (region fallback).

ops-pager: final note before handoff: please add postmortem owners. I'll create an incident in incidents tracker and assign: mohit (root cause), nyla (infra reprovision), sara (customer comms), eli (routing/ops).

deploy-bot: deploy success: scaleup/dedicated-usw2-fallback completed (run id: deploy-9876) :thumbsup:

infra-monitor-bot: RESOLVED (mitigated): overall error rate back down to baseline, affected nodes will be reprovisioned offline. Incident flagged for postmortem.

ops-pager: handing off thread to oncall-2; will follow up in morning for RCA. :white_check_mark:

nyla: leaving notes: consider autoscaler cooldown tuning and node image patch to address kernel+driver mismatch.

mohit: uploading collected logs to incident ticket: https://incidents.redwood.internal/2117778888/artifacts

sara: thanks all — closing oncall loop.
